finding: The author-labelled self-review fallback preferred the structured presentation in 7/7 fixed cases. The preference margin was narrow for the two thematically coherent evidence sets (1980_133 and 2013_35) and wider where the retrieved evidence included apparent relevance noise. Case 2013_35 also identified that the identical generic uncertainty boilerplate is visually clear but substantively uncalibrated to retrieval quality.
